hero.lead: From construction to the table, through land and digital — Groupe TKR designs, builds and operates four complementary divisions, with the same standard of speed and solidity.

about.title: One group, four divisions, one signature
about.p1: Founded in Yaoundé, Groupe TKR built its reputation on construction sites before diversifying into real estate, agribusiness and digital services. Each division operates with its own expertise, under one shared standard: deliver fast, deliver well.
about.p2: This four-division structure lets the Group master the entire value chain — from constructing a building to developing the land it stands on, to the digital tools that run its sites.
